Run `hyperframes auth status` first, every time, resuming included, and report plan or credit details honestly when relevant.

- **Not signed in.** Say in one line that templates come with Pro, then ask them to run `hyperframes auth login` themselves and reply "done".
- **Signed in on Free.** Say once that templates are part of HyperFrames Pro, ask them to run `hyperframes billing subscribe --feature templates --skill style-sampling` themselves if they want to upgrade, and pull nothing.
